Harlan set the letter on the mantle, turned back toward the stairs, and climbed to tend the flame.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，只余下微弱的呼吸。街灯把空无一人的马路染成昏黄，偶尔一辆出租车滑过湿漉漉的路面，轮胎碾过积水发出细碎的声响。早点铺的灯已经亮了，蒸笼里白雾翻涌，老板娘系着围裙在案板前揉面，动作沉稳而熟练。远处，环卫工人的扫帚有节奏地划过人行道，像一支朴素的乐曲。天际线还是深蓝色的，但东方已隐隐透出一丝灰白。这座城市尚未醒来，却已经有人在为它的苏醒做着准备。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple situation where it already knows the answer and stops calling itself, so it doesn't go on forever.\n• For example, to add up the numbers 1 through 5, you can say: the answer is 5 plus the sum of 1 through 4, which is 4 plus the sum of 1 through 3, and so on, until you reach 1, which is just 1 — then you add everything back up."}
